tweets.text: As there are a lot of questions what I meant here: If there is heuristic for solving the game simple enough to be coded by codex, RL will find it and optimize towards it. But it is clear that such heuristic is not generally intelligent and will not generalise. The bottleneck to RL generalization lies in environments where simple heuristics get you far and it’s easy to get stuck in local optimum.
